description: This Java source file defines the JuelConnector class, which customizes the JUEL expression language library to support auto-vivification in the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes that extend AST node classes and parser components to modify behavior for setting values on list or map structures.

classes.name: JuelConnector
classes.description: A facade class that connects the OFBiz framework to the JUEL library, providing customized expression factory creation and AST node classes for auto-vivification.

classes.name: ExtendedAstBracket
classes.description: Custom AST node class extending AstBracket to implement auto-vivify behavior for list or map structures.

classes.name: ExtendedAstDot
classes.description: Custom AST node class extending AstDot to implement auto-vivify behavior for property access.

classes.name: ExtendedParser
classes.description: Custom parser extending Parser to support auto-vivify during expression parsing.

classes.name: ExtendedBuilder
classes.description: Custom builder extending Builder to use ExtendedParser for building expression trees.

methods.name: newExpressionFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a customized ExpressionFactory instance with extended behavior.
